brief:
The Palestinian Investment Fund and Jerusalem Electricity Company held talks aimed at strengthening their partnership and developing the region's energy infrastructure, the Ma'an news agency reported. The two entities explored ways to deepen cooperation on power sector initiatives and expansion projects serving the Jerusalem area.

No specific agreements or timeline for implementation were announced following the discussions. The meeting underscores ongoing efforts by Palestinian institutions to coordinate on electricity services and channel investment into energy systems across the territory.
title: Palestinian investment fund, Jerusalem electricity company discuss energy partnership
